data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'hadaya', which means 'to give' or 'gift'. In Islamic tradition, Hadiya is a name given to a girl, symbolizing the idea of a precious gift or reward from God. The name Hadiya carries the meaning “Gift, Reward” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hadiya usually hope their child will grow to embody gift, reward and live with faith, good character and purpose.
